## Documentation checks

- [ ] Changes are limited to the responsible provider's tools, or common/cross-provider changes have been coordinated with CILIX.
- [ ] The responsible provider has confirmed technical accuracy.
- [ ] Internal links resolve; new external links are verified with the owner for the intended audience.
- [ ] Access, API, deployment and availability claims match authorised arrangements.
- [ ] Confidentiality, Background IP, licences and software/artefact distribution implications have been reviewed; no secrets or sensitive infrastructure information are included.
- [ ] CILIX review is requested through a verified reviewer or the agreed project coordination route.

CILIX final approval is required. Only authorised CILIX staff may merge; partners and beneficiaries must not merge. Reviewer affiliation is not established by this form.
